corrections.corrected_statement: Four exceptions require notes signed by a physician for a medical need, by a school principal dean or designee for schooling, by an employer for work, and by a parent or legal guardian for an immediate family member.
corrections.note: Added designee as an allowed signer for the school note.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: If you legally change your name or license information you must update it, if you move you must notify the department of your new address within ten days without automatically receiving a new card, and you may request a replacement card for a fee.
corrections.note: Corrected to state that an address report updates the record but does not issue a new card.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: HOV lanes take qualifying carpools, buses, decal low-emission cars, motorcycles per posted counts and hours, show diamonds and Carpool Lane paint, open only at marked entries.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but buses are stated on page 21, not 22.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: You may turn right on red after a complete stop unless a no turn on red sign prohibits it, you must not turn right on a red arrow until green, and you must not drive stop park or leave a vehicle in a bus lane though you may cross it to turn.
corrections.note: Added stop and leave prohibitions for bus lanes.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: White allows stopping only long enough to pick up or drop off passengers, green allows parking for a limited posted time, yellow allows loading and unloading passengers and freight for no longer than the posted time with a noncommercial driver usually staying with the vehicle, red allows no stopping standing or parking except buses at marked bus zones, and blue allows parking with a disability placard or plate.
corrections.note: Added passengers for yellow and standing or parking for red.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: HOV lanes admit only posted carpools, buses, decal low-emission vehicles, and motorcycles through marked entries, unlike the center left-turn lane which any driver may borrow for at most two hundred feet to turn, and slow two-lane traffic must yield at turnouts once five or more followers stack up.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but buses are stated on page 21, not 22.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Start a right turn near the right edge after signaling about one hundred feet ahead and stopping behind the limit line or crosswalk or intersection entrance, you may turn right on red after a complete stop unless a no turn on red sign prohibits it, you must not turn right on a red arrow until green, and you may cross a bus lane to turn but must not drive stop park or leave a vehicle in it.
corrections.note: Added unless no turn on red prohibits it exception.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: White allows stopping only long enough to pick up or drop off passengers, green allows parking for a limited posted time, yellow allows loading and unloading passengers and freight for no longer than the posted time with a noncommercial driver usually staying with the vehicle, red allows no stopping standing or parking except buses at marked bus zones, and blue allows parking with a disability placard or plate.
corrections.note: Added passengers for yellow and standing or parking for red.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Bicyclists traveling slower than traffic must ride as close as possible to the right curb or edge unless passing, preparing for a left turn, avoiding a hazard, sharing a lane too narrow for side by side travel, approaching a right turn, or riding on a one way road with two or more lanes.
corrections.note: Added the two missing exceptions for approaching a right turn and one way roads.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Flashing yellow needs no stop unlike flashing red, flashing yellow arrows leave the turn unprotected unlike green arrows, green still demands yielding to trapped traffic and exit room, and dark signals default to all-way stops.
corrections.note: Flashing red stop rule appears on page thirty nine not page forty.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: In a roundabout drivers must yield to traffic already inside and travel counterclockwise without stopping or passing, choosing the right lane for right turns and exiting in the lane entered when going straight.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported comparison to normal intersections.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Bicyclists have the same rights and responsibilities as drivers with added helmet visibility and right edge duties and night lamp and rear light and reflector requirements, and slower riders must stay right unless passing, preparing for a left turn, avoiding a hazard, sharing a too narrow lane, approaching a right turn, or riding on a multilane one way road.
corrections.note: Added missing exceptions for approaching a right turn and one way roads.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Locked skids follow hard fast braking; four-wheel ABS takes firm pressure, rear ABS eases to rolling then steers into the skid, front ABS releases and straightens, ABS-less cars pump, sunk pedals pump gently with downshifts and emergency brakes, wet brakes dry under gas plus brake.
corrections.note: Four-wheel firm-pressure rule is on page 66, not page 67.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Commute-hour freeway patrols give free gas gallons, jumps, radiator patches, flat changes, crash reports, and free tows to approved spots when dead, refusing private tows, shop tips, motorcycles, and crashes unless directed, all via five-eleven.
corrections.note: Free tow and will-not list and 511 are on page 76, not page 75.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Locked skids answer ABS type with firm, eased, or released pedals against pump-and-downshift fallbacks, while slippery roads staircase down by surface: wet shaves miles, snow halves, ice crawls at five, with shade and bridges freezing first.
corrections.note: Four-wheel firm-pressure rule is on page 66, not page 67.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Temperature extremes split gauge watching between speed-plus-AC discipline and antifreeze-plus-defrost care, freeway failures pull right with right-side exits, five-eleven calls, belted waiting, and rare abandonment, and patrols cover gas, jumps, patches, flats, reports, and tows minus privates, tips, bikes, and crashes.
corrections.note: Free tow and will-not exclusions are on page 76, not page 75.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: If you are under twenty one and caught with alcohol in your vehicle, law enforcement can impound your vehicle for up to thirty days and the court may fine you and suspend your license for one year or may ask the department to delay your first license for up to one year if you do not have one.
corrections.note: Added may and up to qualifiers that the page requires.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: If an officer suspects you are under twenty one and drinking they can require a handheld breath test or preliminary alcohol screening or another chemical test and conviction with blood alcohol of zero point zero one percent or higher may bring revocation for one year plus a licensed program while a screening of zero point zero five percent or higher may bring a breath or blood test requirement and a later test at that level may bring arrest and suspension.
corrections.note: Changed mandatory wording to may as the page states.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: If a collision causes more than one thousand dollars in damage or any injury or death, you or your representative must file a Report of Traffic Accident Occurring in California with the Department of Motor Vehicles within ten days whether or not you caused the crash and even on private property, and failure to file suspends your driving privilege while law enforcement will not file for you.
corrections.note: Added representative filing, ten day and damage injury triggers, and corrected filing details.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: When a collision causes more than one thousand dollars in damage or any injury or death, each driver must have a report filed with the Department of Motor Vehicles within ten days by the driver or the driver representative regardless of fault and even on private property, and the Department of Motor Vehicles adds the collision to the driver record regardless of who caused it.
corrections.note: Corrected to more than one thousand dollars, added representative filing and fault record rule.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: When renewing your driver license eLearning may be an alternative testing option that is a no fail self paced course with quizzes after each module.
corrections.note: Removed the never substitute for original license claim not stated on the page.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export
